subject: physics

hotspots.label: Lever (Rocker)
hotspots.description: The rocker you flip to close or open the circuit's gap.
hotspots.colorHint: Amber rocker bar on the switch body.

hotspots.label: Switch Base
hotspots.description: The body that anchors the contacts and the lever.
hotspots.colorHint: Pale grey block with two posts.

hotspots.label: Contact Posts
hotspots.description: The two metal contacts that touch when the switch closes.
hotspots.colorHint: Brass nubs at the base corners.

hotspots.label: Wire Path
hotspots.description: The in/out wires whose loop the switch decides.
hotspots.colorHint: Cool grey loop running through the base.
hotspots.function: Carries the current the switch gates.

hotspots.label: Bulb
hotspots.description: The load that snaps on or off with the lever.
hotspots.colorHint: Small clear bulb with warm glow.
hotspots.function: Shows the on/off result of the switch.

hotspots.label: Ammeter
hotspots.description: The current gauge that jumps when the switch closes.
hotspots.function: Reads the current the switch lets through.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A simple switch block with an amber rocker, cool wire loop, warm bulb, and green ammeter.
materialNotes: Metallic=0, roughness ~0.5. Rocker smooth amber, posts brass-rough metallic ~0.5; bulb glass clear.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: a switch as the gate of a simple circuit.

GEOMETRY: switch block at center with rocker lever, two brass posts, a loop running to a battery, a bulb at +x, and an ammeter at -x.

INTERACTION: click lever → contacts touch/part; bulb and ammeter flip instantly; an ammeter knob raises current and warms the posts as a safety cue.

NAMED NODES: SwitchBase, Rocker, PostL, PostR, LoopWire, Bulb, Ammeter. 7-9k tris.
